profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Phuong is a Software Engineer specializing in web development

Specialties: C#. Nodejs,Visual Basic, VB Script,ASP.Net MVC, MS-SQL,JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, AJAX, XML,HTML,CSS, Expressjs, Markojs,Bootstrap, REST API,AWS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Supported and maintained Social Service Payment System with .Net/.Net Core
•	Developed robust RESTful APIs for a variety of applications, improving data retrieval and system interoperability.
•	Creating, upgrading, maintaining, enhancing, testing, and replacing existing .Net applications.
•	Optimized Azure DevOps release, pipelines and CI implementation, ensuring automated build, test, and release processes for timely software delivery.
•	Collaborates with DevOps teams to ensure regular, controlled deployment of updates to existing database-driven applications.
•	Designed, developed, and maintained complex SSIS packages to automate the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from multiple sources into the SQL Server data warehouse.
•	Developed and maintained custom reports using SSRS and support ad-hoc reporting requests using complex T-SQL queries.
•	Automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to support code releases for multiple applications, improving deployment frequency and reducing manual errors.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · SQL, C#, JavaScript, AWS, Git, jQuery, API · Azure DevOps

company.name: WA Department of Children, Youth, and Families

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated Zuora REST API into internal web api with MS SQL to conduct custom authentication solutions for IRMI.
• Built window service to import Ace Hardware’s data from SharePoint into a new CRM application.
• Implemented custom payment solution with CyberSource API for Takara.
• Implemented properties search with Google Map API, display/update map pins with map dragging event, zoom in/out..etc
• Implemented CMS application for managing complex and performance-oriented websites with XML schema base.
• Built custom payment REST API and implemented payment processing transaction with Authorize.Net API
• Utilized ASP.Net MVC to build and maintain public facing web application with C#/JavaScript/jQuery/JSON/Ajax…etc
• Integrated client’s existing content from Sharepoint,, Salesforce, Facebook …etc into CMS applications.
• Collaborated with team members to recommend new software development technologies and development processes.
• Performed requirements gathering and functional specification activities.
• Translated business requirements and functional designs into technical solutions.
• Built custom process for Workforce Solutions that integrated DocuWare SDK with IronPDF, generated PDF file and automatically upload file to DocuWare cabinet.
• Conduct design and code reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · HTML5 · ASP.NET Web API · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET MVC · REST API · C# · ASP.NET Core

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built payment solutions with PayPal REST API such as Payment, Payout API.
•	Implemented Facebook REST API to enable log in with Facebook and posting on Facebook feature.
•	Built and designed internal API with .Net Web API to support system components and data layers.
•	Implemented AWS – S3 API / AWS SDK to build and maintain image system such as upload, download, rename..etc.
•	Utilized ASP.Net MVC to build and maintain public facing web application with C#/JavaScript/jQuery/JSON/Ajax…etc
•	Built search system with AWS CloudSearch to provide high throughput performance to customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built Single Sign On services using REST, SOAP web services and SAML model.
•	Developed Internet, Extranet and CRM applications with database driven content. 
•       Developed and maintained dynamic web applications using Classic ASP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
•	Utilized ASP.NET, C#, VB Script, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, Ajax , HTML/CSS & MS SQL to build dynamic web applications with enhanced user interfaces to provide reporting capabilities, data entry with business logic validation.
•	Maintained Integration & Unit test Framework and improved readability of the code, fixed bugs.
•	Created ASP.NET WebForm/MVC and Class libraries containing code for business and data access logic using C#.NET.
•	Managed multiple projects for various clients; collaborated with project team members to schedule project deliverables on site and remotely.
•	Responded to incoming support inquiries and work with project management to improve product quality.
•       Successfully refactored and modernized legacy code to improve performance and maintainability.

positions.title: ASP.Net Developer
positions.description:
•	Built and maintained complex websites in ASP.Net.
•	Developed custom database driven web applications in support of client business needs.
•	Utilized ASP.NET, C# & MS SQL Server to build dynamic web applications with enhanced user interfaces to provide reporting capabilities.
•	Compared and deployed changes to SQL Server database schemas using RedGate tools.

positions.title: Xbox Compliance Tester
positions.description:
•	Performed black box test, smoke testing and performance testing base on BVT and functional specifications.
•	Run test cases establishing technical compliance, standardized delivery of test results to all services.
•	Responsible for preparing test procedures, documenting test results, and maintaining bug reports in software quality management systems.
•	Accurately write-up bug reports using PC-based tools, determined failure issues and reported to the team lead.
•	Performed responsibilities of testing hardware and software used in the games.
